en.p: For a geometric sequence $\{a_n\}$ with positive first term and rational common ratio, the series $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_n$ converges, and the sequence $\{a_n\}$ satisfies the following conditions.

box: (B) The sequence $\{a_n\}$ has exactly 3 terms that are integers, and the product of these three terms is $216$.

en.p: When $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_n=\frac{q}{p}$, find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
